newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firms but trade stays thin, arb shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firms but trade stays thin, arb shut.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were firmer in line with crude and NYMEX gasoline futures on Monday, but trade was thin with good supplies keeping buyers relaxed.
Traders said the key ARA Eurograde market continued to talk on a two-tier basis with Rotterdam running refinery barges assessed around $4 a tonne over those with general ARA options.
Prompt Rotterdam refinery liftings were offered around $191 although most traders felt the seller had little chance of achieving this level. General ARA lift were talked $185/$186 fob.
July swaps were traded a couple of times at $182 fob ARA.
Firmer NYMEX gasoline futures on ACCESS pushed up NWE cargo prices a little but talk was thin with the arbitrage window still closed. Eurograde cargoes were assessed around $190 a tonne cif NWE.
